vision_observations: Full ERP is visibly smoother than hard_select/DB74 around the large camera-block boundaries, especially the road band and right-side wall/vehicle region.
Same-ROI sheet shows hard block seams are softened across all four marked ROIs; the result is more viewable than DB74 and the conservative DB75 variants r16/r32/r48.
The method does not geometrically align target surfaces. It source-mixes in the seam band and slightly softens lane/curb/road/wall-base details.
No inpaint/generation/model output, black hole, or DB66-style blob is visible, but mixed pixels mean it is not single-source truth.
accepted_claim: current best viewable seam result version; presentation-only/source-mixed; not source-faithful repair
next_route_audit: DB75 gives a viewable fallback but not a general source-faithful solution. The next technical route, if continuing, should be a separately briefed source-backed local alignment/operator-eligibility route with per-pixel warp vectors and residuals, or a segment-level abstain/eligibility map; do not tune DB75 blending as if it solves geometry.
